concepts.title: Told in order
concepts.logline: One day of a ceramic bottle, each section later than the last.
concepts.why: It shows a ceramic bottle changing instead of describing it.
concepts.world: The ordinary places of a ceramic bottle, in plain daylight.
concepts.signature_moment: The last image of a ceramic bottle changes how the first one reads.
concepts.risk: It only works if the small changes are visible at a glance.
